text:
kai: Noticing a small but persistent bump in 504s from eu-west1 since 02:08 UTC. Suspect recent prefix buffer cap increase in v3.2.1-prod. Proposing a tiny revert image registry.redwood/inference:v3.2.1-slim. Request expedited slim canary + rollforward if green.
mira: paste one-line log sample and rollback plan pls.
kai: log: `2026-04-10T02:09:12Z inference-12 error: prefix_buffer>cap -> reclaim -> timeout 504`
rollback: pin to v3.2.0, cordon & drain new nodes, redeploy; runbook ref RB-621 "hotfix-rollback-slim".
mira: propose 2-node canary in eu-west1, 10m watch, then 30% for 8m, then full. Disable autoscaler on canary and set mem limit back to 7Gi. I can approve if CI smoke passes.
ops-bot: CI smoke for registry.redwood/inference:v3.2.1-slim: passed. Oncall assigned to kai until 2026-04-10T06:00Z. Alerts: high-5xx, p99-latency.
deploybot: Deploy requested by kai -> eu-west1 canary (2 nodes) image registry.redwood/inference:v3.2.1-slim. Starting 10m observation.
(deploybot) 02:21 UTC: canary 2/2 ready, healthchecks OK, 5xx trending down.
kai: good. watching p95/p99 and memory graphs.
mira: 10m observed, canary stable. I authorize ramp to 30%. +1 SRE.
deploybot: Ramping to 30% for 8m.
02:35 UTC - deploybot: 8m observation complete. 5xx down ~91%, latency steady, no OOM traces.
kai: proceeding with full rollout to eu-west1. keeping a short 10m watch.
mira: final +1 from SRE, standby for rollback.
deploybot: Full rollout complete in eu-west1. Tag: registry.redwood/inference:v3.2.1-slim. No alerts during watch windows.
ops-bot: changelog reminder: add internal note.
kai: added changelog and created RB-621 follow-up to add integration tests for prefix buffer changes. Marking thread resolved once changelog published.
